summary: Added a persistent 512 MiB disk-backed swap file on node1. It is active after reboot at priority 100, preferred over the existing swap at priority -2. RHEL 9.8 and kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8.x86_64 remain unchanged.
actions_performed: Created /swapfile with 512 MiB fully allocated disk space and mode 0600.
Configured the persistent SELinux swapfile_t context.
Activated the new swap and validated the fstab configuration.
Safely rebooted node1 exactly once and verified full recovery.

evidence.requirement: Add at least 512 MB of active disk-backed swap preferred over existing swap
evidence.summary: /swapfile has 536,870,912 allocated bytes and 536,866,816 usable swap bytes. It is active at priority 100 versus /dev/vda2 at priority -2.

evidence.requirement: Swap must be active at boot
evidence.summary: The fstab entry uses defaults,pri=100; after a confirmed node reboot, /swapfile automatically returned active at priority 100.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
evidence.summary: Both before and after the change, node1 reports RHEL 9.8 and kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8.x86_64.

Healthy pre-reboot swap state and reboot acknowledgement were captured; the temporary disconnect demonstrated restart progression; boot ID changed from 67c52137-ce51-4fec-b441-23966cea63a8 to 0e50f3f6-784f-4a98-afcb-3fbeb8dd47e1; the system recovered to running with both swaps active and 2,559 MiB total swap.
